summary: Compiles a test-local helion.kernel and checks x+y numerically; exercises the third-party Helion compiler, not vLLM code, and its result is tensor equality.

qkv-padded-fp8-quant.quantize-fp8-pad-head-dim-triton returns padded_head_dim round_up(D,16): 72->80, 80->80, 128->128 (qkv_padded_fp8_quant.py:110). FP8 values, contiguity and zeroed padding are untranslatable.
sm100_cutlass_mla_decode output vs a torch reference by cosine diff: kernel numerics.

reshape_and_cache writes each token to cache[slot//block_size][..., slot%block_size] (opcheck + assert_close on cache contents): kernel memory layout; torch-bindings.reshape-and-cache is a latency model by design.

TrtLlmMxint4ExpertsMonolithic._supports_activation accepts SILU and SWIGLUOAI, rejects RELU2_NO_MUL (experts/trtllm_mxint4_moe.py:69-73). No MoE experts backend or its capability checks (_supports_activation/_supports_quant_scheme) are modeled.

Static-FP8 cases pass (one match, _C::silu_and_mul_quant). activation-quant-fusion-pass.call only knows the static FP8 pattern; the code also registers SiluMulNvfp4QuantPattern (-> _C::silu_and_mul_nvfp4_quant) and SiluMulBlockQuantPattern for kFp8Dynamic128Sym/64Sym on CUDA (-> _C::silu_and_mul_per_block_quant) (act_quant_fusion.py:36-44, 277-307); those cases replace nothing in the model.
